label: PF Backlog 516
title: E9: API/consumer-impact DECISION per item (needs_api + routes + consumers + reason) - mandatory decision, API only when needed
body:
## Problem / why
The dashboard-need is checked per item (dashboard_impact), but the API-need is NOT a per-item decision - a new
backend capability with no API passes silently. The forward-looking consumer is the pipeline-orchestrator UI
(CRUD + operations), which NEEDS APIs. (The current dashboard is legacy and must not be referenced.)

## Goal & value
Every item records an api_impact DECISION - does this need an API surface (for internal orchestration, the
UI/orchestrator, or other consumers)? The decision is mandatory; the API is only built when needed.

## In scope
- api_impact field: {needs_api, routes[], consumers[], reason}.
- api_impact_warnings(): open items without a decision, or needs_api with no routes -> advisory (wired_audit).

## Out of scope
Building the APIs themselves (only when an item declares needs_api=true). Generalising dashboard_impact ->
consumer_impact is a follow-up amendment.

## Acceptance criteria
- api_impact is a dict field; add_epic/update accept it.
- api_impact_warnings flags missing decisions + needs_api-without-routes; wired advisory into wired_audit.
- No new API; no opencode/dashboard references.
